### Bug Description

https://github.com/zomabies/RestoreChatLinks/issues/11

Over the time that I've been building my personal/friend group modpack, I've periodically received a crash on boot with this error: 

[crash-2026-09-21_15.31.17-client.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32453279/crash-2026-09-21_15.31.17-client.txt)

Note: The first mod blamed "at TRANSFORMER/advancementoverhaul@0.10/dev.ethan.advancementoverhaul.client.AdvancementOverhaulClient.onScreenOpening(AdvancementOverhaulClient.java:36) ~[advancementoverhaul-0.10.jar%23562!/:?] {re:classloading}" is not relevant - if you remove whatever it blames, it blames something else, and so forth and so forth. The culprit is (whatever recent mod installed that triggers this).

For my case, the most recent one I can remember is Restore Chat Links (1.21.1 Neoforge).
When I add it to my modpack, this error triggers.

When I Remove it, I can play just fine.

When I add this mod but remove Modernfix, I can also play just fine.

Do you perhaps have any um... well, smarter, eyes/insight into this? AI diagnosis is not that reliable but it talks about something with Restore Chat Links reporting jar tampering or something...


"SecurityException: Jar Has been tampered! true false false
at restorechatlinks.neoforge.IntegrityVerifier.selfVerify

ModernFix appears to alter or clear NeoForge’s SecureJar metadata during startup. Restore Chat Links’ overzealous integrity verifier then interprets the missing trust metadata as a tampered JAR and aborts. With ModernFix disabled, that metadata remains available and RCL loads."

issues.title: mixin.perf.fix_loop_spin_waiting causes chunk delivery stalls with C2ME, should be auto-disabled like other chunk-related mixins
issues.body:
When running ModernFix alongside C2ME, mixin.perf.fix_loop_spin_waiting (enabled by default) appears to delay how quickly the main thread picks up chunks that C2ME has finished generating/loading asynchronously. ModernFix already auto-disables several mixins when C2ME is detected (mixin.bugfix.paper_chunk_patches, mixin.perf.cache_strongholds, mixin.bugfix.chunk_deadlock), but fix_loop_spin_waiting is not part of that override list, even though it affects the same tick-loop wait mechanism that C2ME's chunk system relies on.

Spark profiles show significant time in ServerChunkManager.getChunkBlocking() → waitForTasks() → parkNanos(), and separately, ModernFix's own waitLongerForTasks() wrapper accounts for a large share of server thread time:

https://spark.lucko.me/GocyTurLj9
https://spark.lucko.me/6tZSVyS8Jb

This matches a previously reported case on C2ME's own tracker, where a user isolated the same option and confirmed that disabling mixin.perf.fix_loop_spin_waiting restored normal chunk loading performance.

**To Reproduce**
Install ModernFix and C2ME together on Fabric 1.21.1
Generate/load chunks under normal play (movement, exploration, elytra, etc.)
Profile the server with spark
Observe time spent in waitLongerForTasks() / getChunkBlocking() → parkNanos()

**Expected behavior**
Since C2ME replaces the vanilla chunk task scheduling entirely, mixin.perf.fix_loop_spin_waiting probably shouldn't be active when C2ME is present,  similar to how the other chunk/tick-related mixins are already disabled automatically for compatibility.

**Versions**
ModernFix: v5.25.1+mc1.21.1
C2ME: c2me-fabric-mc1.21.1-0.4.0-alpha.0.19
C2ME OpenCL Acceleration Module: same version
Loader: Fabric
Minecraft: 1.21.1

**Workaround**
Manually setting mixin.perf.fix_loop_spin_waiting=false in modernfix-mixins.properties resolves the issue for us.

issues.title: mixin.perf.faster_ingredients breaks many recipes from Prefab mod (especially conditional recipes)
issues.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I am reporting a defect, not asking for help
- [x] I have searched existing issues and this has not been reported
- [x] I have reduced my mod list to the minimum required to reproduce this issue (see below)

### Bug Description

## Description
Enabling `mixin.perf.faster_ingredients` (default: true) breaks a large number of recipes from the **Prefab** mod.

Prefab uses a custom conditional recipe system that allows recipes to be enabled/disabled via config. When this optimization is active, many Prefab recipes (including Swift Blades, Sickles, and other conditional recipes) fail to load or appear in JEI/EMI.

Note: Not literally every single recipe is broken — some basic recipes still function — but the majority of Prefab’s recipes (especially those using conditional loading) are affected.

## Expected Behavior
All Prefab recipes should load and function normally regardless of ModernFix performance mixins.

## Actual Behavior
Many Prefab recipes become unavailable or broken when `mixin.perf.faster_ingredients = true`.

## Environment
- Minecraft: 1.21.1
- NeoForge: 21.1.228
- ModernFix: 5.27.5+mc1.21.1
- Prefab: 1.0.6
- Cloth Config: 15.0.140 (required dependency for Prefab)

## Additional Information
Prefab developer (Brian Wuest) confirmed this is a **ModernFix-side issue**, not a Prefab bug.  
Quote from Prefab developer:
> "Found issue, turn off the setting: mixin.perf.faster_ingredients. This for some reason is what is causing ALL of Prefab's recipes to be broken! Not just the ones you pointed out. ... This needs to be reported to the Modern Fix mod team as this is not something I can fix within Prefab."

Workaround: Setting `mixin.perf.faster_ingredients = false` immediately restores all affected recipes.

### Minimal Mod List

**Minimal reproduction list:**

- ModernFix 5.27.5+mc1.21.1 (NeoForge)
- Prefab 1.0.6 (NeoForge)
- Cloth Config 15.0.140 (NeoForge) — required dependency for Prefab

Optional (for easier recipe verification):
- JEI or EMI

This issue can be reproduced with only the above three mods (plus JEI/EMI if desired).  
No other mods are required.

### Reproduction Steps

1. Create a new instance with only ModernFix + Prefab + Cloth Config (plus JEI/EMI if needed).
2. Set `mixin.perf.faster_ingredients = true` in `config/modernfix-common.toml`.
3. Launch the game.
4. Open JEI or EMI and search for "swift blade" or "sickle".
5. Attempt to view or craft any Prefab item (e.g. `prefab:item_swift_blade_wood`).
→ Many (or most) Prefab recipes are missing or broken.

6. Change the setting to `false`, restart the game, and confirm that the recipes are restored.

### Diagnostic Info

**Please attach the following files:**
- `latest.log` from `.minecraft/logs/` (the session where the issue occurred)
- `modernfix-common.toml` (your current config)

**Additional notes:**
- No crash occurs — recipes simply fail to load/register.
- This issue was first discovered while troubleshooting missing Prefab recipes in a large 1.21.1 NeoForge modpack.
- Prefab developer has already confirmed the root cause is in ModernFix.
- The issue affects conditional recipes in particular.

issues.title: Crash on startup with `mixin.perf.dynamic_resources=true` — incompatibility with Create: Teleporters

labels.name: cannot reproduce
labels.description: The issue is not reproducible with the information given

issues.body:
## Crash on startup with `mixin.perf.dynamic_resources=true` — incompatibility with Create: Teleporters

**ModernFix version:** `modernfix-neoforge-5.26.1+mc1.21.1`
**Minecraft version:** 1.21.1
**NeoForge version:** 21.1.224
**Create: Teleporters version:** `createteleporters-remastered-2.0.1d-neoforge-1.21.1.jar` (latest) [Create: Teleporters 2.0.2a](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-teleporters/version/2.0.2a)

### Description

When `mixin.perf.dynamic_resources=true` is manually enabled in `config/modernfix-mixins.properties`, the game crashes at startup during the title screen render phase.

The crash does **not** occur when:
- `mixin.perf.dynamic_resources` is removed/set to `false` (game launches fine with all other mods), **OR**
- **Create: Teleporters is removed** from the mod list (game launches fine with dynamic_resources still enabled)

This confirms the crash is a direct incompatibility between `dynamic_resources` and **Create: Teleporters**.

### Exception

```
java.lang.IllegalStateException: Tried to lookup sprite, but atlas is not initialized
    at net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.TextureAtlas.getSprite(TextureAtlas.java:144)
    at net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiSpriteManager.getSprite(GuiSpriteManager.java:23)
    at net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics.blitSprite(GuiGraphics.java:394)
    at net.minecraft.client.gui.components.AbstractButton.renderWidget(AbstractButton.java:35)
    at net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.TitleScreen.render(TitleScreen.java:289)
```

### Crash Report

<details>
<summary>crash-2026-04-23_19_09_17-client.txt</summary>

Minecraft crashed. The logs have been uploaded to `gnomebot.dev`:
### [latest.log](<https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/82CmTTh>)   |   [debug.log head](<https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/3FKR4Yh>) / [tail](<https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/a3GSg9m>) (~47k lines)   |   [crash-2026-04-23_19.09.17-client.txt](<https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/HAhKGn0>)   |   [PrismLauncher-0.log](<https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/Qbw7ciR>)   |   KubeJS: [client.log](<https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/u1YXAge>) / [startup.log](<https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/orINhJr>)   |   [crash_assistant_app.log](<https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/TeQOqbp>)   |   [modlist.txt](<https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/txlerCs>)
```ansi
Found [2;34m1[0m log analysis results:
[2;34mCreate6Addons[0m in: crash-2026-04-23_19.09.17-client.txt
```
### [Mod list changes](<https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/soEs8ga>) on top of the modpack:
```ansi
[2;32m66[0m added, [2;31m1[0m removed, [2;34m1[0m updated.
```

</details>

### Steps to reproduce

1. Install ModernFix + Create: Teleporters on NeoForge 1.21.1
2. Add `mixin.perf.dynamic_resources=true` to `config/modernfix-mixins.properties`
3. Launch the game → crash at title screen

### Current workaround

Disable `mixin.perf.dynamic_resources` in `config/modernfix-mixins.properties`, or remove Create: Teleporters.

issues.title: DynamicModelSystem, CacheLoader returned null for key life_steal:revive_beacon
issues.body:
### Bug Description

Technical Issue with atlases and overlays in resource pack.

In Stoupy51/LifeSteal#13, a user report their game crashing when opening a chest with a particuliar item model (accepted by vanilla Minecraft), their crash report is given in the "log file" part of this issue.

In LifeStealFR, to avoid "multiple atlas" problem with 1.21.11+ and keeping compatibility with version range of 1.21.5 - 26.1+, the item model [`assets/life_steal/models/item/revive_beacon.json`](https://github.com/Stoupy51/LifeSteal/blob/main/build/resource_pack/assets/life_steal/models/item/revive_beacon.json) references textures that are added to either the ["blocks" atlas](https://github.com/Stoupy51/LifeSteal/blob/main/build/resource_pack/before_format_73/assets/minecraft/atlases/blocks.json) (before 1.21.11) or ["items" atlas](https://github.com/Stoupy51/LifeSteal/blob/main/build/resource_pack/format_73_plus/assets/minecraft/atlases/items.json) (starting 1.21.11) depending on the pack overlay
```json
...
"overlays": {
	"entries": [
		{"formats": [0,72],"directory": "before_format_73","min_format": 0,"max_format": 72},
		{"formats": [73,1000],"directory": "format_73_plus","min_format": 73,"max_format": 1000}
	]
}
```

Removing this behavior on my side would either mean I would have to duplicate the vanilla texture in the pack as proper .png files instead of reused the default ones, or drop compatibility for previous 1.21.11 versions.

In my opinion, ModernFix should be able to resolve the atlas reference (if I correctly understand what is happening)

### Reproduction Steps

Download and Enable the LifeStealFR resource pack: https://github.com/Stoupy51/LifeSteal/releases/tag/v2.0.1

Type `/give @s stone[item_model="life_steal:revive_beacon"]` => this will crash your game

issues.title: Integrated server watchdog not sending thread dump when server thread stalls in a certain save
issues.body:
### Bug Description

This issue report is related to a user in FTB Discord having trouble loading their save.
Context is modpack FTB Stoneblock 4 (1.4.0), using MC 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.216, ModernFix version `modernfix-neoforge-5.25.1+mc1.21.1`, when loading a (certain) save in Single Player.
Pack comes with a `modernfix-mixins.properties` shipped by default overriding one entry (`mixin.perf.model_optimizations=false`), not touching `mixin.feature.integrated_server_watchdog` from default of true.

There's an issue caused by Irregular Implements mod in the pack that under certain conditions indefinitely stalls the server thread on save load (https://github.com/FTBTeam/FTB-Modpack-Issues/issues/10755). This is usually quickly recognised in crash assistant reports, as ModernFix does an integrated server thread dump normally on this stall, where it becomes quickly obvious that it's this issue based on where the Server Thread is stuck. In this case, updating irregular implements fixes this issue.

However, for this one user's save, this doesn't happen. I could reproduce this, using Java `21.0.4+7-LTS` (bundled by FTB App), user had it happen on `21.0.7+6-LTS`, and then me again on `21.0.9`. I had to get a thread dump by doing a `jstack` output on it.

When I added a `mixin.feature.spam_thread_dump=true` override to `modernfix-mixins.properties`, it successfully does a thread dump every minute, including after this stall, in which the Server Thread is all stuck on Timed Waiting, so it seems capable of doing a dump it's just not triggering to do it for some reason despite the indefinite stall.

### Reproduction Steps

Unfortunately, I don't know what's different about this user's save that doesn't trigger this behaviour, that all previous saves with this issue do normally trigger a thread dump for.

I've included the user's save here (deleted other dimensions + trimmed down their dimension to reduce save file size, while still able to reproduce the issue): [New World.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24194416/New.World.zip)
Loading this in a fresh unmodified FTB Stoneblock 4 (pack version 1.4.0) seems to reproduce this issue.

### Log File

Example logs where save loading stalls but no ModernFix integrated server thread dump happens: [Latest.log](https://mclo.gs/IWXq0WW) (mine) | [Latest.log (Head)](https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/ZXLow2Y) [Latest.log (Tail)](https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/0r5Laab) (part of user's original report)

This crash doesn't specifically mention ModernFix but only happens when ModernFix is installed along with a set of ~16-100 other mods. It is by far the most inconsistent error I have ever encountered. It seems to only happen half of the time, sometimes with long stretches of failures or successes in a row. (For a while I was able to successfully launch by deleting and regenerating all the config files every launch, no idea if that was just a coincidence or not).

I cannot find any pattern to the successes or failures so it's difficult to try the binary search mod removal method to determine what other mods could be contributing to this. I eventually narrowed it down to ModernFix with many hours of relaunching the game with different mod combinations. I have confirmed the crash only occurs when ModernFix is installed (after many dozens of launches with and without the mod to ensure that it isn't a fluke).

In my original attempts to identify the error, I tried arbitrarily removing mods that were not specifically mentioned in the list above to see if anything else was contributing. When I got down to around ~100 mods, the crashes started reporting this error instead (full crash report and stacktrace in the logs at the bottom):
```
java.util.ConcurrentModificationException: null
```

The ModernFix version I did most of my testing on was 5.24.4-mc1.20.1 but I tested a few times on 5.25.1+mc1.20.1 as well (newest version at the time of posting) and still encountered the issue(s).

### Reproduction Steps

I genuinely have no idea how to reproduce this because of how inconsistent it is. I am just hoping the logs are enough figure out what the problem could be.

The closest I can provide to reproduction steps is to download all of the mods listed in the crash report and try to run the game, but even that might not work. I tried testing on two additional computers with the exact same set of files that caused the crash as the first. On the first computer, I got 8 crashes in a row. The second computer only had the crash 2/8 times, and the third did not have any crashes after launching around 25 times.

On my main device I have successfully ran the game with all ~160 mods half of the time and the other half it crashes. The smallest mod list I have been able to reproduce the crash with is ~100 (see the second log/crash report below), however that seems to show a different set of errors, as mentioned.

I'd be happy to provide more information to help test if the logs below aren't enough to draw any conclusions, but I have no idea how exactly to reproduce this consistently.

### Log File


I am including two different logs and crash reports here with the two different errors. The first is with all ~160 mods used in this modpack and the second is a smaller list from when I was trying to remove mods for testing purposes

The first crash shows that a number of components are already registered when certain mods try to register them again.

The second crash gives a ConcurrentModificationException. The suspected mod is listed as MoonlightLib, but the crash still occurs without it; when it is removed, no suspected mod is listed at all.

Both of the crashes _only_ occur when ModernFix is installed.

issues.title: [1.21.1 NeoForge] CRITICAL: NullPointerException Cascade (Create/AE2/Apotheosis) caused by registry_event_progress

labels.name: cannot reproduce
labels.description: The issue is not reproducible with the information given

issues.body:
### Bug Description

Hello, 

I am reporting a critical incompatibility/race condition found in a complex NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack (160+ mods, heavily optimized with Lithium/Sodium).

The issue causes a **cascading mod loading failure (FATAL CRASH)** due to multiple major mods failing to access their own registered items during the loading process.

###  Bug Description

When loading a large pack, the game crashes during the `net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.RegisterEvent`. The error indicates that the item registration has been accelerated too aggressively, causing key mods to crash upon self-referencing an item that has not yet been fully bound by the system.

###  Errors Observed in Crash Logs (The 'Unbound Value' Cascade)

The crash logs consistently show the same `NullPointerException` (NPE) for key items across multiple major mods.

| Mod ID | Version | Crash Error Snippet |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **create** | v6.0.7 | `NullPointerException: Trying to access unbound value: ResourceKey[... create:brass_hand]` |
| **apotheosis** | v8.4.0 | `NullPointerException: Trying to access unbound value: ResourceKey[... apotheosis:sigil_of_withdrawal]` |
| **ae2** | v19.2.17 | `NullPointerException: Trying to access unbound value: ResourceKey[minecraft:item / ae2:inscriber]` |
| **cataclysm_spellbooks** | v1.1.9 | `NoClassDefFoundError` (This was a side-effect of the registry collapse, now confirmed stable after fixing the root cause). |

### Reproduction Steps

###  Diagnosis and Solution (The Fix)

The issue was diagnosed as a race condition caused by the `ModernFix` mixin that speeds up the registry event progress bar.

* **Culprit Mixin:** `modernfix-neoforge.mixins.json:feature.registry_event_progress.GameDataMixin`
* **Result of Mixin:** The accelerated registry processing executes item logic before the `DeferredHolder` is fully bound by the NeoForge `RegisterEvent`.

**The most effective and stable fix was to disable this specific optimization:**

1.  Navigate to the configuration file: `config/modernfix-mixins.properties`
2.  Add the following line to the end of the file:

    ```properties
    mixin.feature.registry_event_progress=false
    ```

###  Environment Details

* **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1
* **Mod Loader:** NeoForge (v21.1.213)
* **ModernFix Version:** v5.24.3+mc1.21.1
* **Diagnosis Context:** The fix stabilizes the pack, allowing concurrent loading of mods that heavily rely on `DeferredRegister`.

issues.title: Crashed when stitching big textures
issues.body:
### Bug Description

When using reimplemented texture stitching algorithm with a lot of (big) textures, the game crashed with invaild memory access. In vanilla, the game's behavior should be removing all resourcepacks and report an error but not to crash. 

According to the log, this may because the algorithm ignored max stitching texture size and tried to create big stitching (32768x16384x0), then visited wrong VRAM area. This only happens on Core GPUs because their dedicated VRAM is smaller than others. Seems like Minecraft doesn't like shared VRAM in these kind of GPUs, as the VRAM analyzing showed that it never rises to an unexpected level and there's a lot of free.

I've tried replacing GL options in Blaze3D to force enable GL Compression, but failed because of textures away. Maybe you can study it deeper and implement it as another external option.

*P.S.: Don't tell me to remove mods or resourcepacks, or change a computer. They're necessary and I've optimized them as possible as I can. My computer is new.*

issues.title: first load results in tag errors on client side with crafttweaker script

labels.name: fixed in beta
labels.description: Development builds are available with the fix

issues.body:
On forge 1.20.1

mods on both server and client
- crafttweaker 14.0.57
- modernfix 5.23.1

Script on the server side

`server.zs`
```
craftingTable.remove(<item:minecraft:white_concrete_powder>);
craftingTable.addShapeless("concrete", <item:minecraft:white_concrete_powder> * 8, [<tag:items:forge:cobblestone>]);
```

This can happen long as your script references any valid `<tag:xxx>`

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c0f0a1a1-defd-44bf-9d2e-f8020a30fa2e)
```
Internal Exception: io.netty.handler.codec.DecoderException: java.lang.RuntimeException: Error while converting ingredient 'net.minecraft.world.item.crafting.Ingredient$TagValue@43b9ed30' to an IIngredient!
```

Finally, join the server and the error shown prevents you to join the server for the first few tries. Eventually you may get in, and subsequently there will be no problem rejoining until you restart the client.

## Additional testings
If I downgrade to modernfix 5.21.0 on the client only, and keep the server on 5.23.1, there is no error message. Indicating this is a client side issues

5.22.0 on the client is also having the problem

issues.title: ModernFix 1.21.4 repo is not buildable
issues.body:
### Bug Description

When attempting to compile the latest 1.21.4 branch of ModernFix with Gradle, The compiler complains about kubejs and rhino libraries not being found.

### Reproduction Steps

1. Clone the 1.21.4 branch,
2. Run `gradlew build` in the cloned repo,
3. Wait for a while,
4. Get the 404 error.

### Log File

The logs can be found [here](https://pastebin.com/raw/DKShzBXw).

issues.title: Dynamic Resources breaks Additional Placements' model baking
issues.body:
### Bug Description

When Additional Placements attempts to bake models for most stairs variants and vertical slabs (as in only some blocks have this issue, not that some of the variants always bake), the model baker fails to function.
(More info [here](https://github.com/FirEmerald/AdditionalPlacements/issues/140))

### Reproduction Steps

1. Install Additional Placements and ModernFix
2. Enable ModernFix's Dynamic resources and restart
3. Load into a world and place a slab or stair vertically
(You can also just load into a world with already placed vertical slabs/stairs and it'll work)

### Log File

[latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20521920/latest.log)

[debug.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20521922/debug.log)

issues.title: Options to fine tune spark startup profiler
issues.body:
Commandline options for things like interval and thread regex (and maybe even timeout) rather that using hardcoded values.

issues.title: Weird Behavior With Dynamic Resources and CIT [Forge 1.20.1]
issues.body:
### Bug Description

I've been trying to troubleshoot some odd behavior that's happening with CIT packs and ModernFix's Dynamic Resources functionality.

I've got a large modpack (500+ mods) that I'm throwing together. With Dynamic Resources disabled, some vanilla textures, as well as any CIT textures, break. However, this _**only**_  occurs when over ~350 mods are enabled. Any combination (I tried dozens) below that threshold, and the textures don't break and CIT works as expected.

Example of missing textures with Dynamic Resources disabled:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/aaf931aa-87f7-47ad-80bf-b88396416c4b)

When I enable Dynamic Resources, the vanilla textures work again, but CIT textures and some textures from other mods (most commonly patchouli books) do not work.

Example of missing textures with Dynamic Resources enabled:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/40d9f00f-8626-4b0a-8acd-fe14bb3c30e5)

Doing a fresh install with the Optimized FPS modpack (https://modrinth.com/modpack/optimized-fps) also has CIT resource packs refuse to load with Dynamic Resources enabled.

The only place I've found something similar mentioned was here: https://github.com/Sinytra/Connector/issues/820

I tried the steps mentioned in that thread (removing Better Archaeology and enabling Dynamic Resources), but the textures still fail to load.

### Reproduction Steps

For testing Dynamic Resources with CIT:
1. Download [Optimized FPS](https://modrinth.com/modpack/optimized-fps)
2. Download any CIT resource pack (I used [Bibliophilia](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bibliophilia))
3. Attempt to load CIT resource pack (it should fail)

Additional steps for testing with 350+ mods
4. Disable Dynamic Resources
5. Restart
6. Enable CIT pack (It should work)
7. Add mods until going past ~350 mods (Textures, including vanilla should break)
8. Enable Dynamic Resources and restart (Vanilla textures should be fixed, but CIT textures and some modded item textures will still be broken)

### Log File

Dynamic Resources Enabled w/ 500+ mods: [latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19640265/latest.log)

issues.title: Dynamic resources makes framed drawers from Storage Drawers invisible
issues.body:
### Bug Description

When installed alongside Storage Drawers making a framed drawer results in both the item and block being totally invisible. I'm unsure which side this is on but I figure that pinpointing which mixin is causing it at least gives a workaround.

### Reproduction Steps

1. Have both the latest Modern Fix and Storage Drawers installed (Fabric, 1.20.1)
2. Attempt to create a framed drawer using the framing table (seems like every block texture is affected)
3. Take the invisible item from the output slot and place it

### Log File

[latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19388986/latest.log)

ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException crash on 1.20.1
issues.body:
### Bug Description

Hi there!

I'm on Forge 1.20.1 with ModernFix 5.20.2. I'm running a custom collection of around 350 mods.

I've been dealing with a persistent crash in recent days. Basically whenever I teleport to another area away from my base (using either Waystones or Xaero's map), I get a crash due to "exception ticking world," due to java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. The crash log also references PersistentEntitySectionManager. Sometimes the game will just crash straight to desktop, while other times it will hang and need to be aborted manually. 

I've tried disabling various mods that I thought might be the culprit (Distant Horizons and others) with no success - until I tried disabling Modernfix. Now I can load into distant chunks without crashing. 

Very possible that the crash is actually caused by something else and Modernfix is just the catalyst, but figured it might be useful information anyway. I've attached my crash log below.

### Reproduction Steps

Have ModernFix enabled

Teleport to a distant chunk using any means

Crash immediately

issues.title: Issue With Text Shadow On ModernFix 1.21.4
issues.body:
### Bug Description

This isn't really a "bug", but I wanted to create an issue to ask about it anyway.

As of the latest ModernFix version (specifically the 1.21.4 version, this doesn't apply to the 1.21.1 version), there appears to be a hidden change that causes text shadow to no longer render on the HUD. On some multiplayer servers with custom HUD elements, such as MCC Island in my case, this is incredibly obvious, and makes many elements of the HUD look far worse.

Example without ModernFix 5.20.1+mc1.21.4:
![Example without ModernFix](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c5b227a4-5eb8-4494-b4d6-4901c0066262)

Example with ModernFix 5.20.1+mc1.21.4:
![Example with ModernFix](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/42dd267c-a736-484f-89bd-91ecc52fe49b)

I'm sure this is likely a part of an important optimization, and probably can't just be undone, but is there any chance you could add an option to disable said optimization, alike how you can disable others? Even with every config option disabled, this is still the case, and it'd be awesome to have the option to re-enable text shadow, even if it's at the cost of performance.

### Reproduction Steps

1. Install ModernFix 5.20.1+mc1.21.4
2. Connect to MCC Island (or presumably any server with custom HUD elements)
2a. If MCC Island, the issue applies to the action bar and bossbar. You can make the bossbar appear by queueing for a game

### Log File

N/A (I don't think this applies here as I'm not reporting a bug or a crash, but if a log may still be relevant, let me know 🫡)

issues.title: [NeoForge 1.21.1] BiomesOPlenty lag spikes with dynamic resources
issues.body:
**NeoForge version**: 21.1.90
**ModernFix version**: 5.20.0
**Biomes O' Plenty version**: 21.1.0.7

### Bug Description

To elaborate on the title, observing "Anomalies" in Biomes O' Plenty's End Corruption biome causes lag spikes when dynamic resources is on. This *probably* can't be reproduced without a bunch of furniture mods etc. installed though (for block model fodder).

### Reproduction Steps

1. Install ModernFix and Biomes O' Plenty
2. Install a bunch of furniture mods, or your choice of any mod with a large number of blocks w/ custom models
3. Turn dynamic resources on
4. Enter a world and `setblock` a `biomesoplenty:anomaly[type=volatile]`
5. Experience lag spikes

### The Cause

The reason for these lag spikes becomes somewhat obvious once one knows what these "anomalies" do. Indeed, they [take the appearance of random blocks in the registry](https://github.com/Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty/blob/1.21.1/common/src/main/java/biomesoplenty/block/entity/AnomalyBlockEntity.java#L34) with the `type` determining how frequent this happens. Normally this isn't a huge problem ~~(unless you're Immersive Engineering, apparently)~~ but it quickly becomes catastrophic with dynamic resources since (I assume) it triggers the baking of possibly many models per tick.

### Potential Solutions

I've attempted to fix this myself by using the following mixin to limit the blocks in question to vanilla ones, and it seems to work pretty well:

```java
@Mixin(AnomalyBlockEntity.class)
public abstract class MixinAnomalyBlockEntity {

	@ModifyReceiver(
			at = @At(value = "INVOKE", target = "Ljava/util/stream/Stream;map(Ljava/util/function/Function;)Ljava/util/stream/Stream;"),
			method = "*", // We're targeting a lambda in <init>
			require = 1)
	private Stream<Map.Entry<ResourceKey<Block>, Block>> limitToVanilla(Stream<Map.Entry<ResourceKey<Block>, Block>> original, Function<?, ?> mapper) {
		return original.filter(entry -> "minecraft".equals(entry.getKey().location().getNamespace()));
	}
}
```

Other solutions of course include 'freezing' the anomalies so they keep whatever block they started with (although this would not entirely solve the problem and it would make the anomalies less... anomalous), and/or just making it their problem.

issues.title: Blast Search Trees incompatible with EMI
issues.body:
### Bug Description

EMI is gradually replacing JEI and REI, I think it would be very helpful if you could add compatibility between EMI and ModernFix's Blast search trees feature. Right now, both Creative and EMI utilize their search features at the same time causing very slow Creative menu loading with a lot of mods. I turned on force blast search trees, and it's MUCH faster. However, Creative Search doesn't load as there isn't compatibility between search trees and EMI.

### Reproduction Steps

Turn on Blast Search Trees Force feature and with EMI.

issues.title: Dynamic Resources changes the behaviour of Fabric Api's `getModel()`
issues.body:
### Bug Description

The class `ModelManager` has two different overloads for `getModel`:   
The vanilla implementation takes a `ModelResourceLocation` as argument, and falls back to returning a missing model.  
Fabric Api's implementation takes a plain `ResourceLocation` as argument, and falls back to returning `null`.

When ModernFix's Dynamic Resources is enabled, Fabric Api's overload returns a missing model instead of null, which can throw off mods that rely on detecting missing models.

The context for this is similar to #433, but involves a different overload of `getModel`. This time it will be trivial to work around this on my end, so there's no urgency to fix this, but I still thought this behaviour was worth documenting.
(And honnestly I have no idea why those two behave differently to begin with. I might just take this issue to Fabric Api as well.)

### Reproduction Steps

- Install [Enchants-CIT v1.0.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchants-cit/version/1.0.0+1.21)
- Search for enchanted books with the newest enchantments (e.g windburst)
   - Without Dynamic Resources: the item uses the vanilla texture.
   - With Dynamic Resources: the item has a missing texture.

### Bug Description

issues.body:
> [!NOTE]  
> This issue is duplicate of **RyoamicLights** issue [(#26)](https://github.com/ThinkingStudios/RyoamicLights/issues/26).

##

### **Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
Users have reported that the lighting system behaves unexpectedly or inaccurately when both mods ModernFix & RyoamicLights Mod are active. This affects the overall visual quality of the game and can lead to immersion-breaking experiences.

### **Describe the solution you'd like**
**1. Compatibility Patch:**  We should create a compatibility patch specifically for the ModernFix Mod. This patch would address any conflicts related to lighting calculations and ensure smooth gameplay.
**2. Testing and Debugging:** Rigorous testing is essential to identify the exact cause of the buggy lighting. We’ll need to reproduce the issue, analyze logs, and debug the code to pinpoint the problem.

### **Describe alternatives you've considered**
**1. Workaround Documentation:** We could provide clear instructions to players on how to manually resolve conflicts between the two mods. However, this is not an ideal solution, as it requires technical knowledge and can be cumbersome for users.
**2. Collaboration with ModernFix Developers:** We could reach out to the developers of the ModernFix Mod and collaborate on finding a common ground for compatibility. This might involve adjusting our modpack or suggesting changes to their mod.

### **Additional context**
Users have been requesting this compatibility enhancement, and it would significantly improve the overall user experience. Let’s prioritize this feature to enhance our modpack’s appeal and ensure a smoother gameplay experience for our community.

## Why i created this issue?
I intend to replace the `LambDynamicLights` mod with `RyoamicLights` in my modpack, ‘OptiNa Reborn.’ However, there is a compatibility issue with a third-party mod called `ModernFix`.

issues.title: Missing models are unidentifiable with Dynamic Resources.

labels.name: fixed in beta
labels.description: Development builds are available with the fix

issues.body:
### Bug Description

Hi, 

I'm the creator of a mod called Invariable Paintings. This mod adds new item models for each painting variant in the game, which are conditionally applied to the vanilla painting item. (Those models work fine, even with Dynamic Resources.)
I support modded paintings, but those don't come bundled with the corresponding item models. I don't consider these missing models to be an error, instead I have a built-in default model, which is used for any variant with no model of its own.

This fallback model is the only model that does not work with Dynamic Resources. It doesn't prevent the model from being loaded, but messes with the logic that decides when it should be used: 
```java
BakedModel model = modelManager.getModel(Cits.OfPainting(variantId));

if (model != modelManager.getMissingModel()) // This condition is always true with Dynamic Resources
	return model;
else
	return modelManager.getModel(Cits.CIT_FILLED); // Intended fallback.
```
([Full code](https://github.com/Estecka/mc-invariable-paintings/blob/8b2aab2547bcd016f98653720b940333fa37d270/src/client/java/tk/estecka/invarpaint/cit/mixin/ItemRendererMixin.java#L44), yarn mappings)

It seems Dynamic Resources generates missing models whose identity is different from the one returned by `getMissingModel`, making them undetectable.

### Reproduction Steps

- Enable Dynamic Resources.
- Install [Invariable Paintings v2.1.0+1.21](https://modrinth.com/mod/invariable-paintings/version/2.1.0+1.21). Dependencies are not required
- Install any datapack (or mod) that adds new painting variants to the game. Corresponding texturepack is not required.
- In-game, search "Painting" in the creative inventory. Scroll down until you find the newly added ones.

Behaviours without (top) and with (bottom) dynamic resources:
![Modernfix](https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/assets/39855800/34aeda89-33d2-407f-89a0-3d166dd21809)


### Log File

The log doesn't seem to contains anything of note. There are some warnings about the added paintings not having a model, but I'd say those are expected. Presumably they occur on the first line of the code snippet above.

labels.name: fixed in beta

The `RenderLivingEvent` has a fatal flaw causing mods that cancel the event to break the pose stack silently. We should patch this since many legacy mods will likely never be updated.

https://github.com/MinecraftForge/MinecraftForge/pull/9500 has a reasonable solution for this (popping anything that was pushed onto the pose in the Pre event).

issues.title: Server Freeze during World Pre-generation with ModernFix 5.10.0 on Minecraft Forge 1.19.2 (on a BIG modpack)
issues.body:
I'm encountering a server freeze issue when using ModernFix version 5.10.0 with Minecraft Forge version 1.19.2 (forge 1.19.2-43.3.5) and Java JDK-21 on a dedicated Windows 11 64-bit server. 
The issue occurs during the world pre-generation process.

## Modpack
I am using a large modpack : [LMP](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/lmp)

## Server Setup
- **OS:** Windows 11 64-bit
- **Java Version:** JDK-21
- **Batch File Configuration:
```
set JAVA_MCSS="C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-21\bin\java.exe"
%JAVA_MCSS% @user_jvm_args.txt @libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge/1.19.2-43.3.5/win_args.txt nogui %*
```
- **JVM Arguments (`user_jvm_args.txt`):**
```
-Xms4G
-Xmx12G
-XX:+UseG1GC
-XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled
-XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200
-XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions
-XX:+DisableExplicitGC
-XX:+AlwaysPreTouch
-XX:G1NewSizePercent=30
-XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40
-XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M
-XX:G1ReservePercent=20
-XX:G1HeapWastePercent=5
-XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4
-XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15
-XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90
-XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5
-XX:SurvivorRatio=32
-XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem
-XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1
-Dusing.aikars.flags=https://mcflags.emc.gs/
-Daikars.new.flags=true
```

## Issue
The server freezes without any error messages or logs when I execute the `/pregen start gen radius Test SQUARE 0 0 300 minecraft:overworld FAST_CHECK_GEN` command.
There is no crash, but the server becomes unresponsive.
Players can move within already loaded chunks, but this is only due to their local cache; they cannot interact with anything in the game world.
Server logs show that the pre-generation process has frozen, but there are no error messages or any additional information.
The same is observed in log4j logs.
Memory dumps do not reveal any apparent issues causing the freeze.


## Troubleshooting Steps
- Attempted to diagnose with Log4j configurations.
- Memory dumps were attempted without success.
- Disabled mods in batches of 15 to isolate the problem.
- Identified that disabling ModernFix seems to resolve the issue.

## Comparison with Previous Version
The issue does not occur with ModernFix version 5.9.3 under the same conditions.

issues.title: ModernFix removes EverlastingAbilities' search ability
issues.body:
I'm a modpack developer, and I just stumbled upon this problem and I cannot for the life of me figure it out. The mod Everlasting Abilities usually allows players to search in creative mode for specific ability totems, but in combination of ModernFix that feature is broken, making it so that only one totem shows up when searched. So far in survival worlds it's been Speed 1 and in creative worlds it's been Absorption 1. I've narrowed it down to ModernFix specifically in the context of my pack (Duad Beruzhaldan), but having only Everlasting Abilities, ModernFix, and the respective requirements/strong recommendations in a profile doesn't reproduce the problem. Everything's worked fine with Everlasting Abilities until I added ModernFix, so I know none of the other mods in my pack are a problem.
I'm going to keep trying to figure this out, but I'm utterly baffled and if there's any way that you guys can help that would be wonderful. The developers of Everlasting Abilities had nothing helpful to say when I submitted the issue report to them.

Steps to reproduce the problem:

    Load versions 1.2.81 or 1.2.82 of the modpack Duad Beruzhaldan. ModernFix was added in 1.2.81.
    Load the game and go into creative or otherwise search for 'ability totem'.

Expected behaviour:

Usually I'm able to search and select specific totems to use at the start of a game (often for roleplaying a character but usually because I'm quite fond of step assist). Usually, when I search 'ability totem' (or just 'ability') a selection of all available totems appears in the creative menu, and when I search for a specific one - ie step assist - it shows up.

Versions:

    Everlasting Abilities: 1.8.2
    ModernFix: 5.9.3
    Minecraft: 1.18.2
    Forge: 40.2.10

issues.title: [Fabric 1.20.1] ModernFix causes Creative inventory search to always be empty
issues.body:
This only happens when paired with certain mods, such as CarryOn (but there are PLENTY of others). Otherwise, removing ModernFix, the creative search works with all of the mods I have installed. Only problem: game hardly loads anymore because ModernFix also happens to be what keeps the game functioning. But I really need Creative's search function to work, because the way crap gets sorted in Creative is brain-meltingly dumb and I can never find what I need without scouring for minutes at a time.

Without ModernFix: if the game loads, typing "ee" in Creative search shows a bunch of items with "ee" in the name.
With ModernFix: the game WILL load for sure, but typing "ee" in Creative search (or even just "e") shows absolutely no items.

Worth noting it SORT OF seemed to work on Fabric Loader 0.14.23, but I had to downgrade to 0.14.22 to use Polymorph because for some reason no one's updating it to support 0.14.23. Now it's completely broken if ModernFix is installed.

Why is it doing this? Why is ModernFix even touching the Creative search function at all? Please help.

labels.name: fixed in beta

issues.body:
Reproducible on at least [Vampirism](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/vampirism-become-a-vampire) 1.9.5 and Modernfix 5.7.2 with Dynamic Resources enabled. Likely applies to all recent versions of vampirism other than 1.19.2, but I haven't tested them thoroughly.

issues.title: Use platform remapper for ASM transformer
issues.body: The current system is hardcoded to only work with Intermediary, SRG, and Mojmap, which will break dev environments using Yarn, or any other non-Mojang mappings set. This does not affect the vast majority of players but is necessary for developers using ModernFix with their mod's development environment.

issues.title: [1.19.2] Critical Bug: Game hangs when generating new chunks
issues.body:
I have a fairly critical bug right now in:
Forge 43.2.21 1.19.2
with modernfix-forge-5.7.1+mc1.19.2

Whenever I generate a new world the world will hang and never get past 100% generated.
ingame it becomes an eternal waiting for server moment in an existing world which remains joinable until new chunks are made.

I grabbed a thread dump with visualVM, but I have no idea which could possibly be wrong, but than the fact that this modpack of over 290 mods was running before I added modernfix in hopes of bringing down some overhead for some friend's sakes. So while the game loads a lot more optimizedly, it's literally unplayable now except for void worlds or already generated places in existing maps.

https://pastebin.com/i8FBGZNa

I did notice before posting this message: https://github.com/embeddedt/ModernFix/issues/118#issuecomment-1574482144

I turned off the chunk deadlock thing, and it actually started working. So I'm not sure whats wrong with it but atleast you've got a lead.

Something like:

```
#  mixin.bugfix.concurrency=true

Or:

```
#  mixin.bugfix.concurrency # Default: true
```

issues.title: Custom item icon and texture issue with Vault Hunters 3

labels.name: fixed in beta
labels.description: Development builds are available with the fix

issues.body:
I know it is a very niche usage issue but i've noticed it and it may be a sign of a bigger problem so i thought it'd be better to warn people that it exists.

Vault Hunters 3 have their own custom items (chromatic iron sickle as an example). By default when loaded with ModernFix, item image gets replaced with a texture square (probably because those items generate their inventory icons using textures).

Using `mixin.perf.faster_texture_loading=false`, disabling this mixin seems to fix the issue.

Using Vault Hunters 3, 3.10.1 version, currently latest. MC 1.18.2, Forge 40.2.1, ModernFix 2.7.1

If you need more information i'd gladly provide it. There is no crash log as there is no crash

issues.title: mixin.perf.faster_texture_loading is incompatible with QSL

**MC** 1.19.2
**[QSL](https://modrinth.com/mod/qsl)** 4.0.0-beta.30
**ModernFix** 3.5.0

The game simply crashes on startup, unless I set the config value `mixin.perf.faster_texture_loading=false`. Everything else seems to work perfectly fine. Let me know, if this needs to be reported to QSL, instead, especially since you didn't explicitly tag Quilt as supported.

issues.title: Incompatibility With DashLoader & Suggestions
issues.body:
Hello, I noticed that ModernFix does not play nicely with DashLoader after the mod gets cached.

I have used the original mod [Chunk Saving Fix](https://github.com/SuperCoder7979/chunksavingfix-forge) a long time ago which do have this problem too, but this mod seemed to be at end of life, so I didn't report the problem to SuperCoder7979.
Fortunately, this strange terrain appears rarely, but it would be nice if you can fix it.

issues.title: Crash when generating stronghold
issues.body:
I had already been to the end.Then I added this mod.
Then I ran 40,000 meters away to find a new stronghold.
But the ender eye points in the direction of the spawn point.
I ran 12,000 meters, which is still far from the stronghold.
I finally found it around X:-6000 Y:~ Z:3000.
It's strange that there is a stronghold every three kilometers on average.Anyway, the ender eye should not lead me there.
Then I created a new file.I threw the ender eye.Then the game crashed.
This seems to mean that there is something wrong with the generation of stronghold.

issues.title: Rarely, text is displayed incorrectly with Modern UI installed
issues.body:
At present, there are two situations. The first is that the number of items disappears after entering the archive. The second is that a single item is not affected, and the items with numbers all become "S".
Of course, these are all display problems, in fact, the number of items has not changed. And the probability of encountering it is relatively small, but it is quite annoying because I have to restart the game.
